items.name: Wake on Magic Packet
items.description: Wake on Magic Packet controls sleep/standby and wake orchestration.
items.shortDescription: Wake on Magic Packet controls sleep/standby and wake orchestration.
items.longDescription: Adjusts wake on magic packet through sleep/standby and wake orchestration. Performance-oriented values reduce ramp delays but increase draw and heat.
items.whatItDoes: Writes and tracks wake on magic packet so Falcon can apply, verify, and rollback consistently for this policy family.
items.whyGamersCare: It is mostly a power-behavior control and usually has limited direct gaming benefit.
items.fpsImpact: Average FPS impact is generally minimal.
items.latencyImpact: Latency-sensitive users may notice faster wake/ramp and steadier input response.
items.powerImpact: Conservative values favor lower power at the cost of responsiveness.
items.heatImpact: Thermal impact is usually modest unless combined with other aggressive settings.
items.stabilityRisk: Medium when changed without hardware-specific validation.
items.recommendedFor: Only for controlled experiments with rollback ready.
items.avoidIf: Avoid if you cannot benchmark changes or need strict OEM-default behavior.
